problem_plain: Two companies with different distribution models and operational systems were considering a joint venture, and integrating their incompatible systems risked derailing the deal.
capability: Systems integration planning and merger operations consolidation
reusable: Experience with operating brewing company systems and expertise in integrating different distribution and delivery networks during business combinations.
summary: Veridane created a comprehensive plan for integrating the two companies' operations, grounded in experience running Carlsberg's systems. The approach reduced time and cost whilst enabling the joint venture to grow.
